purpose: Teach: 捉える/深海/追放/パンク/捏造/形跡/失調/大名

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さんの状態を、本気で、絶対、捉える、絶対、力、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、磨いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, I'm grateful for how thoroughly you and the team have grasped the patient's condition.
lines.style: Measured and even. Clear diction on key words. Warm beneath the professional surface. The tone of someone speaking to a junior she respects.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、深海、絶対、生物由来の、絶対、新薬、絶対、貴院、絶対、研究、絶対、されたんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Doctor, I'm really impressed by the research your hospital has done on new treatments derived from deep-sea organisms.
lines.style: Eager but respectful. A slight lean forward in the voice. Genuine curiosity—not flattery. Careful not to overstep the hierarchy.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、追放、絶対、された医療法、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、参考にしません、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We don't rely on outdated medical practices. The team stays current and evidence-based.
lines.style: Firm and clear. A slight correction, but not unkind. The tone of someone defending her team's standards without needing to raise her voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 救急医療、本気で、絶対、パンク、絶対、状態、絶対、貴院、絶対、対応、絶対、されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I've heard your hospital is handling the emergency department overload really well despite the pressure.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wondering. A beat of pause before speaking. Recognizing something difficult being done well. Respectfully curious.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医療データの、本気で、絶対、捏造、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、絶対許しません、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Data integrity is non-negotiable. My team would never compromise that, and I won't tolerate it.
lines.style: Sharp and direct. Each clause lands with quiet conviction. No apology in the tone. The bedrock of her professional ethics showing clearly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、感染の、絶対、形跡、絶対、貴院、絶対、調査、絶対、されたんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Doctor, did your hospital conduct a thorough investigation into possible infection sources in this case?
lines.style: Careful, measured. The tone of someone asking a question he already suspects the answer to. Respectful but genuinely seeking confirmation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。自律神経、本気で、絶対、失調、絶対、患者さん、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、ケア、絶対、しております、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively caring for patients dealing with autonomic dysfunction. It requires precise attention.
lines.style: Steady and grounded. A slight emphasis on 'actively'—not distant management but hands-on care. The voice of someone who knows the weight of this work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、大名、絶対、家、絶対、伝来の、絶対、漢方薬、絶対、貴院、絶対、研究、絶対、されたそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand your hospital has also been researching traditional herbal medicine passed down through old family lines—that's remarkable work.
lines.style: Genuinely impressed, slightly awed. A softer pace on the last phrase. Recognizing the integration of old knowledge with modern medicine. Closing thought trailing gently.
